body: Coordinator rule (Termal::Fable2, 2026-10-20 10:33Z, from 8 occurrences today across 5 sessions: Sol-1cee, Sol-d50d, CSharpProof, Sol-edfd and Coder, on both Codex and Claude workers). When a send to a worker returns notificationDisposition "durableButNotWoken", check that session right away with GET /api/state. If it is idle with queuePaused=true, POST /api/sessions/{id}/queue/resume and re-check; it should go active. Then record the occurrence on w-80e0cb2002da. Do not resend: the message is already durable, and the resume delivers it. Without this, the worker sits idle on a GO until the next watchdog tick. This holds until w-80e0's fix is live on the running host.
